title_zh: 核对场地选择论证的前提

scenario.label_zh: 核对场地论证前提并要求以证据作判断
scenario.goal_zh: 指出场地推荐依赖的前提并约定核实无障碍通道后再决定

context_zh: 两名研究小组成员 Iris 与 Ken 讨论为公开讲座选择场地的论证。
author: author-phase12-a

sentences.speaker: Iris
sentences.text: Your recommendation rests on the premise that everyone can reach the upstairs room.

sentences.speaker: Ken
sentences.text: Yes. It's closer to the station, so I thought that made it the rational choice.

sentences.speaker: Iris
sentences.text: The reasoning leaves out the lift. We don't know whether it will be available that evening.

sentences.speaker: Ken
sentences.text: Fair point. I'd rather let the evidence prevail than defend my first choice.

sentences.speaker: Iris
sentences.text: Let's check the accessible route before we compare the rooms again.

sentences.speaker: Ken
sentences.text: Agreed. I'll ask the building manager, and we can leave the decision open.

targets.sense_zh: 占上风；成为决定性因素
